text:
emily: quick idea  we should standardize a minimal migration checklist PMs can run without deep infra help. keep it short.
rafael: yes. idea: three lanes - infra, quality, customer opt-ins. each lane returns PASS/WARN/FAIL.
zoe: metrics: p95 delta <= +20ms, semantic regression <2% on core suite, cost delta <10%. WARN means opt-in only.
marc: ops: add 2 canary modes: internal (5% traffic) and invited (customers who opt-in). ramp plan: 0->5->25->100 over 48-72h.
tina: UX: Console needs an "invited cohort" toggle + per-customer pin flag. also show a short risk sentence and estimated cost delta.
emily: playbook sketch:
- ingest + tokenizer checks
- microbench (64/256/1024) -> p95/throughput/memory
- semantic eval vs baseline (core + customer holdouts)
- internal canary (24h) -> invited (14d opt-in) -> default swap (72h ramp)
rafael: automated rollback rules: if semantic regression >3% sustained 30m OR p95 >50ms for 1h OR user error rate x2 -> auto rollback. reversible pin for 7 days.
zoe: variants: if quantized fails semantic gate then route to fp16 variant. document fallback in routing layer.
marc: add simple CLI `rw-migrate --new X --old Y --suite core` that emits PASS/WARN/FAIL and links logs. hook to deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rw-migrate started for `catalog/zephyr-v2` vs `zephyr-v1` (suite: core). ETA 10m.
emily: action items: rafael -> thresholds doc (48h), zoe -> eval suites + customer holdouts (48h), marc -> CLI + ops runbook (72h), tina -> Console toggles copy (72h). i'll publish the one-pager after.
deploy-bot: rw-migrate finished: result=warn (long-context semantic diffs). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/migrate/2141812345
emily: thanks bot  zoe/rafael triage the long-context failures. if they persist block default swap but allow invited cohort.
zoe: on it. initial triage shows hallucinations on >2048 token prompts. will add focused long-context tests.
rafael: will draft a short risk blurb for Console: "Known long-context regressions: invited-only until fixed."
emily: good. reconvene after triage.
